zh: 全球经济正在缓慢复苏。
en: The global economy is recovering slowly.

zh: 通货膨胀率已连续三个月回落。
en: The inflation rate has fallen for three consecutive months.

zh: 中小企业是就业的主要来源。
en: Small and medium-sized enterprises are a major source of employment.

zh: 今年上半年社会消费品零售总额同比增长了百分之五。
en: Retail sales of consumer goods grew by five percent year on year in the first half of the year.

zh: 出口订单回暖，港口集装箱吞吐量创下历史新高。
en: With export orders recovering, container throughput at the ports hit a record high.

zh: 新能源汽车出口大幅增长，成为外贸新的增长点。
en: Exports of new energy vehicles have surged, becoming a new driver of foreign trade.

zh: 青年就业压力依然不小，许多毕业生选择灵活就业。
en: Youth employment pressure remains, and many graduates are choosing flexible work.

zh: 央行下调存款准备金率，释放长期资金支持实体经济。
en: The central bank cut the reserve requirement ratio, releasing long-term funds to support the real economy.

zh: 直播带货正在改变年轻人的消费习惯。
en: Livestream shopping is changing the spending habits of young consumers.

zh: 房地产市场仍在调整，各地出台了不同的支持措施。
en: The property market is still adjusting, and cities have rolled out different support measures.

zh: 制造业采购经理指数连续三个月回升，企业信心有所增强。
en: The manufacturing purchasing managers' index has risen for three straight months, and business confidence is improving.

zh: 跨境电商发展迅速，越来越多的小商品卖到了海外。
en: Cross-border e-commerce is booming, sending more and more small goods overseas.

zh: 服务业回暖带动了餐饮、旅游和住宿行业的用工需求。
en: The recovery in services has boosted hiring in catering, tourism, and hotels.

zh: 全球供应链正在重组，不少企业采取多元化布局。
en: Global supply chains are being restructured, and many companies are diversifying.

zh: 消费者越来越精打细算，把性价比放在第一位。
en: Consumers are spending more carefully, putting value for money first.

zh: 数字支付普及之后，现金交易的比例逐年下降。
en: Since digital payments became widespread, cash transactions have declined year by year.

zh: 猪肉价格回落，让食品通胀的压力明显减轻。
en: Falling pork prices have noticeably eased pressure on food inflation.

zh: 这家老牌制造企业通过自动化改造，把产能提升了一倍。
en: The century-old manufacturer doubled its output through automation upgrades.

zh: 免税购物政策吸引大量游客，海南离岛免税销售额翻倍。
en: Duty-free shopping has drawn crowds of tourists, doubling sales on the island.

zh: 专家提醒，家庭理财要根据自己的风险承受能力来配置。
en: Experts advise households to allocate assets according to their risk tolerance.
